digest.component_or_area: Pandoc corpus verification and Gerrit Verify gate
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay on every Gerrit Verify cell caused a measured 184.32-second macOS performance impact that should be moved out of the per-change hot path while retaining all behavioral assertions.
Committed deterministic Pandoc outputs for all corpus inputs should back broad verification assertions in Gerrit Verify, reducing per-change subprocess work from 42s to ~4s (90.8% reduction).

Three evidence-selected live product-path bodies from code_arrow, table, and prose strata plus compact version/platform/argv/stdin/timeout probes must remain in Gerrit Verify to ensure minimal live conversion coverage.

A dedicated external job with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix arms must run complete full-replay validation of all 1,383 corpus conversions through real Pandoc on a weekly schedule and on workflow_dispatch.
